[[File:ActisDockedWithTRing.png|thumb|250px|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 interceptor]] docked with a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] transport ring.]]

The '''Syliure-45 hyperdrive module''' was a [[Hyperspace transport ring/Legends|hyperdrive docking ring]] that was produced by [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated]] towards the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was designed to offer [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel to star fighters that were too small to allow for an onboard [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], and was the successor to the [[Syliure-31 hyperspace docking ring/Legends|Syliure-31 long-range hyperdrive module]].

With the introduction of the new [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]], The Syliure-45 was developed as an improvement over its predecessor, which was designed for the previous [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]]. The two designs differed due to the addition of four additional accelerator pods. Three pods were located on each side of the ring, which was split in half by the socket which connected the fighter to the ring. Syliure-type hyperspace rings were designed to be adapted to fit a number of Jedi and Republic star fighters. Although the new six-engine variant was primarily designed to work in conjunction with the Eta-2 ''Actis''-class light interceptors, it was also used infrequently by the [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighter]].
